payload.text: Re-drive docs/known-defects.md whole on the pair that includes the fixes for issues 0689 (cc, intentsvcs/src/macapp.rs, which moves DIRT_SCOPE) and 0690 (cc, daemon start's remedy), on vc's word (2026-11-12), as the one drive that counts; the drive at 594422fb4 (1d9e398f3) was its shakedown. refs/bank/ic/kd331/redrive-gyges.sh carries main to gyges:~/Devel/prj/Intent as a git bundle and fast-forwards it, rebuilds the pair with bin/devbin build all, and runs the kit at /private/tmp/kd331 (the rest of refs/bank/ic/kd331/) with stdin from /dev/null. Then mkpage.pl rebuilds the page, pagecheck.sh and refcheck.pl check it, and it is committed here. At the cut's HEAD, reference_current_check.sh exits 0 (cut-surface.md moves with 0690's landing if ALL_VARIANTS does) and the diff from the drive's commit over DIRT_SCOPE is empty. Released when vc says 0689 and 0690 have landed.
